recentItems.title: Families of victims killed in Jordanian strike deny links to church attack | AJ #shorts
recentItems.description:
Jordanian strikes on Syria in retaliation for last week’s church attack killed at least seven people, including a family of five. Amman said it targeted ‘terrorist hideouts’, but relatives of the victims deny any link to the attack. Al Jazeera’s Obaida Hitto reports from Deraa.

recentItems.title: DR Congo nurseries care for children orphaned by Ebola outbreak
recentItems.description:
Thousands of children in the Democratic Republic of Congo are being orphaned or separated from their families by the Ebola outbreak.
In the epicentre of the epidemic, emergency nurseries are providing care for children as their futures remain uncertain. 

Al Jazeera’s Cara Legg reports.
